desc: The garden-first home tutorial (owner decision 2026-11-10, docs/decisions/0005-garden-first.md). State: Save.d.tutorial.gt = {on, did, done, farm, m0, gift}. Only saves started through the hatch get it (on = true); older saves and saves part-way through the farm tutorial never do. Original systems and names: the Chao Garden is a feel reference only.
options_doc: farm_after_matches: expeditions after this tutorial before building and farming open by themselves (Hob opens them any time once the tutorial is over). card_s: how long the centred instruction card shows before it shrinks to the bottom pill. idle_reprompt_s: standing still this long brings the card back. hungry_to: the feed step sets the Boki's Full to this (under 38, so it asks for food). settle_needs_to: at the start the other needs are topped up to at least this, so the Boki asks for food and nothing else. gift: the item the give step hands over (see gifts). train_stat: the stat the tiny training game trains (the one with the most room is used when this one is capped). meet_m: how close counts as saying hi.

sprout_cap.name: Sprout Cap
sprout_cap.desc: A little leaf cap. Boki that wear it feel sturdy.

steps.title: Say hi
steps.hint: Say hi to {name}. Walk over to it.

steps.title: Pet
steps.hint: Press {interact} next to {name} to pet it.

steps.title: Feed
steps.hint: {name} is hungry. Press {interact} next to it to feed it.

steps.title: Play
steps.hint: Press {play} next to {name} to throw a ball. It brings it back.

steps.title: Give
steps.hint: You found a {gift}. Press {interact} next to {name} to give it.

steps.title: Train
steps.hint: Press {interact} next to {name} for a quick training game.

steps.title: Head out
steps.hint: Head out together. Follow {name} to the portal and press {interact}.

done_toast: {name} is ready for the wild. Come home to care for it between runs.
farm_toast: Hob has blueprints for you now. Talk to him to start building and farming.
build_wait: Building comes later. Look after {name} first.
hob_wait: Settle in with {name} first. When you want to build or farm, come and find me.

welcome.sub: This island is yours, and {name} lives here with you.
welcome.para: Get to know {name} first: say hi, pet it, feed it and play. Out in the wild, what you find is only yours once you make it back.
